writeup: TIC 355809352 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 29.438395 days, detected through automated analysis of TESS photometry data. The primary eclipse produces a dimming of 0.08%, with a detection significance of 51.8 in the periodogram analysis. Pixel-level examination confirms the signal with a peak signal-to-noise ratio of 5.5, though the centroid offset of 15.6 arcsec from the target warrants consideration. A secondary eclipse was not detected. The candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it a novel target. However, alternating eclipses show significantly different depths, suggesting the true period may be twice the initial detection - a pattern flagged during automated quality review. This open question does not affect the pixel confirmation or eclipse timing analysis.
